name: Shape Grid
description: Canvas background of a drifting grid of outlined shapes that light up under the cursor with a soft trail, ripple on click, and can be tilted in 3D with optional rainbow glow.
contents: Full-size container div with a single canvas drawing the shape grid
Optional edge fade mask and background color
behavior: Grid drifts continuously in a chosen direction at a set speed
Cells near the cursor light up with a spring-smoothed spotlight and fading trail
Clicking launches a ripple cascade of lit cells (up to 6 at once)
Intro wave reveals the grid outward from the center on mount
Optional random twinkle, rainbow hues, glow, and 3D perspective tilt with distance mist
Pauses drawing when off screen or paused, and stops drifting under reduced motion
editableByProps: Shape, cell size, line width, and line color
Drift direction and speed, or no movement
Hover color, fill color, fill opacity, rainbow mode, glow, and spotlight radius and trail length
3D tilt on both axes, edge fade amount, twinkle, intro and click ripple toggles
Overall opacity, background color, pause, pixel ratio, and extra class or style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change ripple speed, hit strength, or max simultaneous ripples
needsCodeEdit.where: cascadeAt function and the onDown handler
stiffness and damping constants inside the frame function
SHAPES array, layoutFor, centerOf, and traceCell functions

fixed: Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined height and position
Listens for pointer events on window, so the cursor lights cells even when other content sits above it
Cursor effect and click ripple need a pointer; on touch only taps trigger ripples and there is no hover light
Values are clamped: cellSize min 8, tilt within 70 degrees, trail min 0.05
Canvas pixel count is capped at 8 million by lowering resolution
Honors prefers-reduced-motion by disabling drift, twinkle, and intro
Uses ctx.roundRect for the tile shape, which needs a modern browser
Uses a CSS mask for edge fade, so fade 0 disables it
Works at all sizes since it sizes from its container with a ResizeObserver

options.useWhen: Clean technical hero or dashboard-style landing background
Friendly product hero where a soft app-like look is wanted
Network, blockchain, or science themed sections
Geometric, bold agency or gaming headers
Luxury or jewelry style sections needing an angular pattern

options.look: Small plus markers at grid points
options.useWhen: Blueprint or engineering style hero with minimal ink
Subtle backdrop behind dense text or a pricing section
